claim_verdicts.evidence: stage-1 scripts/up.sh: `docker compose up -d --build --wait`; docker-compose.yml api.build: context `.`, dockerfile `DonHang.Api/Dockerfile`; Dockerfile: `FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build` ... `FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS final`. Running lab: `docker image inspect donhang-api:stage-1` -> linux/amd64; /etc/os-release in donhang-api -> Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS; `dotnet --list-runtimes` -> Microsoft.AspNetCore.App 10.0.12.
claim_verdicts.source: examples/don-hang@stage-1: scripts/up.sh, docker-compose.yml, DonHang.Api/Dockerfile; docker inspect/exec on running lab

claim_verdicts.evidence: api has no `ports:` (docker ps: donhang-api `8080/tcp`, unpublished); host curl to 172.28.0.13:8080 timed out. But Caddyfile also has `donhang.local:8443 { ... handle /api/v1/* { reverse_proxy api:8080 } }`, and `curl -k --resolve donhang.local:8443:127.0.0.1 https://donhang.local:8443/api/v1/products` -> 200. So the way in is Caddy on 8080 and 8443, not 8080 only.
claim_verdicts.source: examples/don-hang@stage-1: docker-compose.yml, Caddyfile; curl on running lab
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: The only way in is Caddy, which passes `/api/v1/*` requests on to the API; in this lesson you use its plain-HTTP port, `8080`.

claim_verdicts.evidence: docker-compose.yml api.environment: `ConnectionStrings__Default: "Host=db;Database=donhang;..."`, `Jwt__SigningKey: "${JWT_SIGNING_KEY}"`, `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: "Development"` (exactly three). scripts/dev-secrets.sh: `echo "JWT_SIGNING_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 48)" >> .env`. appsettings.json: Logging, AllowedHosts, Jwt.Issuer, Jwt.Audience only. No appsettings.Development.json or launchSettings.json at the tag.

Ran outside the lab (git archive stage-1 to scratch dir, SDK 10.0.300, no config env vars): `dotnet run --project DonHang.Api` -> `Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException: ConnectionStrings:Default is not set at Program.<Main>$ ... Program.cs:line 16`. With only ConnectionStrings__Default set: `Jwt:SigningKey is not set ... line 23`. Confirms order and the two required settings.
claim_verdicts.source: execution: dotnet run on archived examples/don-hang@stage-1

claim_verdicts.evidence: Compose docs: "Each container for a service joins the default network and is both reachable by other containers on that network, and discoverable by its service name." Execution: inside donhang-api `getent hosts db` -> 172.28.0.11 db; on the host `nslookup db` -> "can't find db: Non-existent domain", `curl http://db:5432/` exit 6 (could not resolve host).

issues.quote: The only way in is Caddy on port `8080`, which passes `/api/v1/*` requests on to the API.
issues.text: Not the only way in: the Caddyfile at stage-1 also proxies `/api/v1/*` to api:8080 on `donhang.local:8443`, and the running lab answers 200 there. The lesson's own point (only Caddy reaches the API) holds; the port is overstated.
issues.fix: Replace with: "The only way in is Caddy, which passes `/api/v1/*` requests on to the API; in this lesson you use its plain-HTTP port, `8080`."

issues.quote: Many programs connect to the database only when the first request needs it, so starting proves nothing about it.
issues.text: Key (c) is correct, but the explanation for (b) is wrong for the API the question names: DonHang.Api runs `context.Database.Migrate()` in Program.cs at startup, so it does reach its database before it starts serving. "Proves nothing" is false for this API.
issues.fix: Explanation b (en): "Some programs reach their database only on the first request; and even one that reaches it at startup can still answer nobody if users cannot reach its address." Update vi to match.

issues.fix: Replace "the .NET 10 SDK" with ".NET 10", or add a half-sentence: "the .NET 10 SDK, the .NET tools that build code,".
